# v5.15 story review, round 0 (low effort): COPY-v5.15.md only

VERDICT: NOT SATISFIED
SUMMARY: The new copy is in voice and funny, and the Boston "coming soon" card picks up the "I'll be waiting in Boston" thread well. The biggest risk is context: recipe lines and rush openers could spoil or introduce story before the player has earned it. I could not check this, because this pass covered the copy document only.

HOOKS:
- S24 [minor] `mastery.all`: "Now I can finally sit down." This is the last line of the post-story, and it closes everything just before the Boston wait. → "Eighteen stars, cara mia. Every shop, every oven. Now I sit down. On the bus. To Boston."

STORY & PACING:
- S22 [minor] `rush.friday.start` (Captain Marisol, "The whole dock's hungry") and `rush.gameday.start` (Dale). If these rushes can fire before Waterfront or Suburbs unlocks, the player meets the character before the unlock scene does. → Gate each rush until its neighbourhood is unlocked. If that isn't possible, give the opener to the head of the current shop.

PLAYER COMMUNICATION:
- S21 [minor] `recipe.waterfront.3` "Baked the night the pier stayed a pier." and `recipe.uptown.3` "It made the front page." These give away the Pier 9 bid result and the uptown-3 review cliffhanger (the same risk as S6). → Before a recipe is earned, its card shows only "???" and a hint (for example "Win the pier."), never the line.
- S23 [minor] `attack.banner` "MegaSlice is coming! Defend your shop." It doesn't tell the player how to win. → Name the action in about 8 words, for example "MegaSlice attacks this week! Out-sell them to win." Use the real win condition.

VOICE & COMEDY:
- S25 [minor] `attack.industrial.open` "Break rooms, all week: MegaSlice. Hot on the outside. Mostly. Your move, pizza person." That is four ideas, so it can't be read in 3 seconds. It is also the third "Mostly." button in this copy (with Mei's "Mostly glue." and the Firewall Calzone card). → "MegaSlice in every break room, all week. Your move, pizza person."
- Smaller note (not tracked): `recipe.waterfront.2` "A ship needs a first mate. So does a pizzeria." spells out its own joke. → "Marisol has a first mate now. She still won't share the wheel."

PROTECT:
- `cameo.nonna.3` "I'm not checking. I'm just… standing." It pays off "Nonna checks." on the recipe cards.
- `attack.industrial.win` "Crew didn't touch the MegaSlice junk. I'm not smiling. Shut up."
- `soon.boston.signoff` "I knit you a sweater. Is ugly. Wear it anyway." It answers "So is the cold."

FIXED SINCE LAST REVIEW: n/a. The scenes are not in this document.
